blocks.title: Commercial Engine
blocks.body: Park Hyatt commercial distribution rides World of Hyatt direct channels, GDS, OTAs, and parent sales systems. Intimate luxury: residential-feeling luxury hotels with World of Hyatt distribution for travelers seeking quiet refinement over large convention product. Owners should underwrite channel mix and loyalty contribution for this asset—not corporate averages alone.

blocks.title: Commercial Differentiator
blocks.body: Versus Grand Hyatt's meetings-led scale, Park Hyatt sells intimate luxury; versus Andaz lifestyle, it is quieter residential luxury inside World of Hyatt.

blocks.title: World of Hyatt

blocks.title: Repeat Guest Capture

blocks.title: Why Value Is Strongest in These Scenarios
blocks.body:
Keep Local Product Intent—Add World of Hyatt: retain Park Hyatt's brand promise while accessing loyalty earn/redeem and parent commercial systems a standalone hotel cannot buy alone.
Intimate luxury: residential-feeling luxury hotels with World of Hyatt distribution for travelers seeking quiet refinement over large convention product.
Sibling Clarity: diligence fit versus same-parent peers before assuming identical owner use case or fee path.
Operator & Owner Fit: strongest when the asset can deliver the brand's guest promise with QA discipline—weakest when sponsors want the flag without the product investment.
Disclosure Discipline: model economics only from current fee exhibits—Factory 2.0 does not invent undisclosed percentages.
